主要内容: The 5G Industrial IOT market is expected to grow significantly, reaching a valuation of US$ 18.8 Bn by 2032, according to a report by Future Market Insights. In 2021, the market was valued at US$ 890.0 Mn, and it is projected to grow at a CAGR of 28.1% from 2022 to 2032. The market is anticipated to reach US$ 18.8 Bn by 2032, with large enterprises expected to grow at a CAGR of nearly 28%. The market plays a vital role in the telecom and manufacturing industries, driven by enhanced connectivity and the adoption of automation technologies. Key players such as Ericsson, Cisco, and Tech Mahindra are collaborating to modernize 5G infrastructure and enhance network capabilities. These collaborations are part of the competitive landscape, where companies focus on innovation, quality, and market presence to remain competitive. The report highlights the potential of hardware within the 5G Industrial IOT market, with hardware revenue expected to grow at a CAGR of about 27.9% during the projection period. China is expected to hold a prominent market share and grow at a CAGR of 27.3%.
